newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Ansett, SIA Air NZ alliance not exclusive.
newsitem.headline: Ansett, SIA Air NZ alliance not exclusive.

text.p: Ansett Airlines, Singapore Airlines and Air New Zealand said on Friday the operations alliance between the three did not exclude the three carriers from pursuing links with other airlines.

"An important part of this document (memorandum of understanding) allows the carriers to pursue other alliances which are within their respective interests," the manager of Ansett's international operations Craig Wallace told a news conference held to announce the deal.
Wallace said he or the other two Airline's represenatives did not wish to speculate on any other possible alliances.

Air New Zealand managing director Jim McCrea told reporters the alliance would not affect the carrier's evaluation of possible membership of the Star alliance between United Airlines, Lufthansa, Air Canada, Scandinavian Airlines Systems, Thai Airways International Ltd and Brazil's Varig Airlines.

"It (the alliance) is really quite compatable with that significant alliance. We are progressively forming partnerships with members of the Star Alliance and that is not incompatable with the Singapore, Ansett, Ansett International alliance," he said.

Ansett managing director Rod Eddinton said the globalisation of the air transport market meant greater competition and was putting pressure on international carriers to consolidate their operations through alliances.
